title: Coding & Build Guard Chain
brief: Pre-tool guards for routing and safety (block destructive ops without approval, validate file paths). Post-tool chains for code quality (lint, format), test impact analysis, and schema validation. Human approval gate for destructive actions.

units.title: Implement pre-tool guard chain: routing validation, file path safety checks, destructive-op detection
Implement human approval gate for destructive actions (git reset, file delete, force push) via elicitation
Implement post-tool code quality chain: lint check, format validation, import sorting on written/edited files
Implement post-tool test impact analysis: detect which tests cover modified files, flag untested changes
Implement post-tool schema validation: verify JSON/YAML outputs match expected schemas, validate API contracts

exit_conditions: Pre-tool guards block destructive ops without human approval
Post-tool quality chain runs lint/format/import checks on code changes
Test impact analysis identifies affected test files
Schema validation catches malformed JSON/YAML outputs
All guards stay within <2K token budget
